description:
About the company
 Our client is an enterprise software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Design and build the AI layer of a software product, defining how the system reasons, coordinates multi-step tasks and interacts with users. The work covers agentic workflows, model integrations, evaluation and reliability, and close partnership with frontend and backend engineers.
 What you'll do
 - Build multi-step agent workflows that track state, propose actions and carry tasks through to completion.
 - Link language models to external functions, stored context and lookup layers that span mixed data sources.
 - Safeguard sensitive information and design fallback behavior for failed tools, incomplete inputs and unreliable model outputs.
 - Set up test harnesses that score how well generative features perform and feed results back into iteration.
 - Tune AI interactions for speed, clarity and user control.
 - Work with frontend and backend engineers to bring AI features into everyday product workflows.
 - Weigh trade-offs between model capability, latency and reliability.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Hands-on record of deploying language-model agents to live users, including function calling, stateful context and self-directed planning.
 - Proven ability to raise the output quality of AI features through systematic scoring and testing.
 - Experience leading multi-quarter technical projects from design through delivery.
 - Expert-level Python backend development skills.
 - Experience building retrieval systems over structured and unstructured data.
 Bonus points
 - Prior work in a small, fast-paced engineering group at a young company.
 - Background in manufacturing or industrial operations software.
 - Master's degree in computer science, mathematics, physics or a related quantitative field.
 - Familiarity with FastAPI.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Salary: $160K - $250K
 - Bonus
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - San Diego, Los Angeles or San Francisco Bay Area, California, United States
 - Hybrid: 3 days per week in office in San Diego, or one week per month in office for Los Angeles and Bay Area employees
 - Full-time
